name: Satake Yukiko
source:
The second daughter of the Ashina siblings. She works at a bento shop. She's plain and unremarkable, yet possesses the largest bust among the three sisters.

As a child, she was a caring and considerate girl, but now she avoids trouble and shows little interest in others. Her policy is to steer clear of hassle and conflict, living a peaceful life.

She schemes to keep her younger brother all to herself, more than she cares about the inheritance itself.

Will the day ever come when she opens her heart and rediscovers her feelings for her family?

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/shimai_s/shimai_s.html]official site[/url]]
